context_loading_rule: Read CURRENT_CONTEXT.md first. Read only the files listed in required_context_files for the active skill.

project_context.purpose: Full project summary, client input, goals, audience, assumptions, and design risks

project_state.purpose: Machine-readable current project state, complexity, generation tool, and phase tracking

competitive_analysis.purpose: Competitor UI patterns, gaps, and differentiation opportunities

ux_strategy.purpose: UX strategy, journey, page hierarchy, conversion flow

wireframes.purpose: Text-based wireframes and IA validation before visual design

design_dna.purpose: Visual design system, colors, typography, layout, motion, anti-AI rules

design_direction.purpose: Three design direction options for client or designer selection
read_when: design dna if direction was chosen

ui_generation_prompt.purpose: Tool-specific UI generation prompt (Stitch, V0, Framer, Figma, Locofy)

ui_critique.purpose: Critique of generated UI output with scores and must-fix list

refinement_prompt.purpose: Humanization plan and refinement prompt for UI improvement

content_strategy.purpose: Final copy: headlines, CTAs, section headings, microcopy, SEO

developer_handoff.purpose: Final implementation handoff with tokens, components, states, responsive rules

design_system_css.purpose: Generated CSS custom properties from Design DNA

design_system_tokens.purpose: Design tokens in JSON format for Figma and tooling

decisions.purpose: Important project decisions that should not be forgotten
